experiment.comment: All the specified experimental uncertainties refer approximately to the 1sigma limits.

The N2O experimental uncertainties were determined as follows. The error of the measurements is 6.5% (fuel-lean mixture, see "Uncertainty analysis" paragraph) but it cannot be less than 10 ppm (signal noise, see Fig. 6.) or, if it is larger than 10 ppm, the absolute value of the minimal measured N2O concentration in the data series if the minimal value was negative.

The smoothed data series were obtained by selecting representative points from the original (raw) data series. The standard deviations of the smoothed data were obtained by linearly interpolating between the standard deviations of the two neighboring original (raw) data points.
